entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return some mountain bike shoes I bought. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here for the VeloFit SummitPro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a fit and preference issue?

It's the fit. They just hurt so much. I've tried wearing them on a few rides, and I just keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for these. I really needed this money back for the holidays, you know?
Oh, I completely understand. Getting blisters from new shoes is the worst, and it definitely ruins a ride. Let me just check the purchase date and our policy for you. One moment.

Alright, Sarah, thank you for your patience. I see you received them 36 days ago. The good news is that these shoes fall under our 90-day return policy. So, I can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I also see you're a VIP member with us, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. For the trouble this has caused, I've gone ahead and added a $25 store credit to your account for your next purchase. I'm sending you a pre-paid return label to your email right now. Just pack the shoes, and the cleats if you've already attached them, back into the original box and you'll be all set.
Wow, a credit too? That's incredibly kind. You've really made my day, David. Thank you so much.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. We want to make sure you get gear that you love. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful holiday season, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
